notes.title: Humdrum Night Save Fix
notes.content: I hope this fixes things!! There's been a few bugs reported around saving/loading during the Humdrums Night at Scumm Bar, this should resolve that!

notes.title: Price Reduced! Play Queer Games!
notes.content:
Cheaper than a dozen eggs in the US, you can now entertain yourself for 4-6 hours in queer community without going outside :)

Now is a good time to celebrate and consume queer stories! To help with that, I've lowered the price of Queer Quest on Steam to $10. It is also $10/pay-what-you-can on itch.io (if Steam had more flexible payment options, it would be pay-what-you-can here as well!)
